description: Search, read, create, update, transition, assign, link and comment on Jira issues, and read projects, agile boards, sprints, issue types, priorities and users on your *.atlassian.net site in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Jira session.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search for Jira issues using JQL (Jira Query Language). Supports filtering by project, status, assignee, labels, and more.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Jira issue by its key (e.g. KAN-1) or ID.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new Jira issue in a project. Requires a project key, summary, and issue type.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update fields on an existing Jira issue. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: delete_issue
tools.description: Delete a Jira issue. Optionally delete all subtasks as well.

tools.name: transition_issue
tools.description: Transition a Jira issue to a new status. Use get_transitions to find available transition IDs for an issue.

tools.name: get_transitions
tools.description: Get available status transitions for a Jira issue. Use this to find transition IDs before calling transition_issue.

tools.name: assign_issue
tools.description: Assign a Jira issue to a user, or unassign it by passing null. Use search_users to find account IDs.

tools.name: link_issues
tools.description: Create a link between two Jira issues. Common link types: "Blocks", "is blocked by", "relates to", "duplicates".

tools.name: add_watcher
tools.description: Add a user as a watcher on a Jira issue. The user will receive notifications for issue updates.

tools.name: list_issue_types
tools.description: List available issue types for the Jira instance. Use this to find valid issue type names for create_issue.

tools.name: list_priorities
tools.description: List available priority levels for the Jira instance. Use this to find valid priority names for create_issue and update_issue.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Jira issue.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments on a Jira issue with pagination support.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List Jira projects accessible to the current user with optional search.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get detailed information about a Jira project by its key or ID.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: List Jira boards (Scrum and Kanban). Returns board name, type, and associated project.

tools.name: list_sprints
tools.description: List sprints for a Jira board. Returns sprint name, state, and dates.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Search for Jira users by name or email. Useful for finding account IDs to use with assign_issue or create_issue.

tools.name: get_myself
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated Jira user.
